issues.description: The template implementation of simulate_msd_two_rounds constructs a Stim circuit using stim.Circuit(p) (passing the simulation parameter p to the Stim circuit constructor). The solution uses stim.Circuit() with no arguments. The Stim Circuit constructor does not accept a probability argument; the template's use of stim.Circuit(p) is inconsistent with the solution and will raise an error for students when they try to run or extend the provided template.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template to construct the Stim circuit with no arguments (stim.Circuit()) to match the solution and Stim's API. Remove the spurious argument 'p' from stim.Circuit(p) in the template's simulate_msd_two_rounds function so students can run the starter code without encountering a constructor error.
